current_detections.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
current_detections.evidence: Market structure shifted from bearish to bullish after price swept the ~60500 low and impulsively rallied above the prior swing high near 61500.
current_detections.missing_conditions: Sustained price action above the 61500 structural level to fully confirm the change of character.

current_detections.name: Bullish Flag
current_detections.evidence: Strong impulsive rally from approximately 60500 to 61850 followed by a shallow consolidation/drift near the top.
current_detections.missing_conditions: Clear formation of parallel flag boundaries and a decisive breakout above the upper flag boundary.

tracked_patterns.name: Liquidity Sweep
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price dipped to approximately 60500 around 08:00, sweeping prior equal lows, before reversing sharply upward with strong bullish candles.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Awaiting sustained break of structure above local highs to confirm bullish continuation.
